findings.description: The code accesses `chargingStation[startingLocation]` and `mapOfChargingStations[startingLocation]` without checking if `startingLocation` exists in those maps.
The function is recursive with no explicit recursion depth limit or cycle detection.
The function does not validate the values in `chargingStation` or the distances in `mapOfChargingStations`.
